info.title: Drawing Reader API
info.description:
Engineering Drawing Register, OCR, BOM Intelligence, Revision Analytics, Weight & BOQ Management.

Authenticate with `POST /api/auth/login` and send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. List endpoints accept `page`, `page_size` and `sort` (prefix `-` for descending). Errors use a uniform envelope `{success: false, error: {code, message, details}, request_id}`.
